name: FreshRSS
description: Feed reader for news, blogs and podcasts, with apps for your phone

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your users, feeds, articles (SQLite database) and settings. Back it up.

paths.name: Extensions
paths.description: Extensions you add yourself, one folder each.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: FreshRSS web app and reader-app API, published on host as 6813

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: CRON_MIN
variables.description: The minutes of each hour when feeds are refreshed, like 3,33 for twice an hour. Leave it empty to turn automatic refresh off.
